title: no autocorrect identity fields
rule: Do not autocorrect names, addresses, or emails; turn spellcheck off on emails, codes, and usernames.

citation.source: NN/g — A Checklist for Designing Mobile Input Fields; Vercel Web Interface Guidelines

pass_when: Name, address, email: autocorrect off. Email, code, username: spellcheck off.
fail_when: Those fields autocorrect or spellcheck as prose.
overview: Turn off autocorrect and spellcheck on names, addresses, emails, codes, usernames.
apply_when: Identity-like fields: name, address, email, code, or username.
not_when: Prose fields where spellcheck and autocorrect help the user.
agent_hint: Disable autocorrect on name/address/email; disable spellcheck on email/code/username.
description: Do not autocorrect names, addresses, or emails; turn spellcheck off on emails, codes, and usernames. Pass when name, address, and email have autocorrect off and email, code, and username have spellcheck off; fail when those fields autocorrect or spellcheck as prose. Prose helpers corrupt identity strings that users must enter exactly as they intend them.
